plainTranslation: {{personA}}'s affection may make it easier to feel liked in your own skin. The warmth is available, but it deepens when someone makes it visible.
summaryShort: {{personA}} brings easy warmth to how you show up. The connection can stay light unless you make the affection more visible.
summaryDeep:
{{personA}}'s Venus sextiles your Ascendant, so their warmth may make you more comfortable being seen. They may compliment your style, invite you into softer spaces, or make you feel like you do not have to work so hard to be liked.

This can create a pleasant rhythm between you. Their approval does not have to be dramatic to matter. Around them, you may become less guarded, more open, or more willing to let yourself be enjoyed.

The opening is there, but it can stay casual. The warmth may remain polite, flirtatious, or surface-level if no one gives it a clearer shape.

Let appreciation become visible. Say what feels good, and name what you enjoy about each other.
tension: The warmth can remain polite or surface-level if no one gives it a clearer shape.
advice: Say what feels good, and name what you enjoy about each other.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Authored to cover planet-to-angle synastry fallback for the relationship interaspect list.
